children: Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $544.1M, a net loss of $12.5M and diluted EPS of $(0.36), compared with revenue of $557.4M, net income of $11.4M and diluted EPS of $0.32 in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue was $544.1M for Q2 2026, down from $557.4M in the year-ago quarter ((2.4%)).
Net income was $(12.5)M for Q2 2026, versus $11.4M in the year-ago quarter (turn to a loss).
Diluted earnings per share was $(0.36) for Q2 2026, versus $0.32 in the year-ago quarter.
Total revenues were down about 2.4% in the quarter and roughly 1.9% year-to-date, driven by a comparable store sales decline of approximately 2.9%.
Mix shifted toward higher food & beverage sales and away from entertainment, increasing product cost percentage and pressuring margins.

Opened seven new stores year-to-date (five Dave & Buster’s and two Main Event), bringing company-owned locations to 250; higher depreciation and pre-opening costs from new stores and remodels weighed on results.
Operating payroll and store expenses rose due to new-store labor and sales deleverage; reduced walk-in traffic and changes in breakage and redemption patterns affected deferred entertainment revenue.
